items.label: Lake crossing at the subsea rate

notes: 56 km crosses lakes; costed as a water crossing

assumptions: We assume building in permafrost costs 1 to 1.25 times the rate elsewhere.
We assume a major road crossing costs C$25,000 to C$100,000.
We assume a minor road crossing costs C$5,000 to C$25,000.
We assume a winter road crossing adds no cost (there is no structure to cross).
We assume a rail crossing costs C$30,000 to C$120,000.
We assume a river crossing costs C$50,000 to C$250,000.
excludes: permits, land rights and railway application fees
electronics, huts and landing stations beyond what the subsea benchmark includes
limitations: Crossing counts are minimums. Roads are CanVec 1:1,000,000, which leaves out most local roads, and rivers are 1:5,000,000. The real line will cross more.
Rates are published averages, mostly from the United States, converted at the 2024 average exchange rate and not adjusted for inflation. They are indicative only and are not a budget estimate.
Permafrost comes from the main soil type of each ecodistrict (AAFC National Ecological Framework); local ground can differ. Sporadic and isolated permafrost are not counted.
Crossing costs are assumptions, not published figures.
